channel.title: The Grant Desk - Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, UK, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, UK, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Youth Music: Trailblazer Fund (Round 14) (closes 20 Nov)
item.description:
Youth Music
Deadline: 20 Nov 2026, 17:00 GMT
Award: GBP 2,000 to GBP 30,000 for organisations in England. No application fee.

Youth Music's Trailblazer Fund gives GBP 2,000 to GBP 30,000 to organisations in England running projects that let children and young people aged 25 or under make, learn and earn in music.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Futures of Listening x Immersive Audio Network: Residency Open Call (Bristol, IAN Festival 2027) (closes 21 Nov)
item.description:
Futures of Listening (FIBER, 4DSOUND, Robin Koek, Art of Sound) and the Immersive Audio Network (IAN)
Deadline: 21 Nov 2026, 23:59 CET
Award: EUR 1,750 residency fee (excl. VAT, paid on invoice), plus return travel from the Netherlands to Bristol and private accommodation for 22 to 30 January 2027. No application fee.

One residency for a freelance audio practitioner (composer, sound designer, audio maker, artist or researcher) registered in the Netherlands, to develop an existing project into a spatial, story-led sound work.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Refugee Festival Scotland 2027 x Opening Shot: Open Call for First-Time Filmmakers (GBP 1,500 fee plus GBP 3,000 production budget) (closes 22 Nov)
item.description:
Refugee Festival Scotland (Scottish Refugee Council) with Opening Shot
Deadline: 22 Nov 2026
Award: GBP 1,500 participation fee plus a GBP 3,000 production budget per filmmaker, with mentoring and a premiere screening at Refugee Festival Scotland in June 2027. Four filmmakers selected. No application fee stated.

Refugee Festival Scotland (run by the Scottish Refugee Council, festival 11 to 20 June 2027) and Opening Shot invite four first-time filmmakers with lived experience of seeking safety to make a short film of about five minutes.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Youth Music: Recharge Fund, Racial Equity (up to GBP 120,000 core funding over four years) (closes 4 Dec)
item.description:
Youth Music
Deadline: 4 Dec 2026, 17:00 GMT
Award: Core funding of up to GBP 120,000 over four years per organisation, from a total pot of GBP 2,400,000. No application fee.

Youth Music's Recharge Fund: Racial Equity gives multi-year core funding to creative organisations across England that are led by communities who experience racial injustice and that work with children and/or young people of different ages and backgrounds.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Cove Park Awarded Residencies 2027-2028 (Scotland, UK, Central and South America and diasporas) (closes 11 Dec)
item.description:
Cove Park
Deadline: 11 Dec 2026, 17:00 GMT
Award: Fully funded: GBP 775 per week fee (VAT inclusive, freelance), travel allowance (Scotland GBP 65 to 200, rest of UK up to GBP 250, Europe up to GBP 400, other international up to GBP 1,250), materials up to GBP 150 for studio-based practitioners, private accommodation and studio, visa and access support. Application Access Bursary available (request by 30 November 2026). No application fee.

Cove Park's biennial call for fully funded Awarded Residencies at its 50-acre rural residency site in Argyll, on the west coast of Scotland, programmed between May 2027 and December 2028.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: BRAID Creative Commissions 2027: A Promise in Return (Responsible AI, GBP 8,000-12,000, Edinburgh Art Festival)
item.description: BRAID (Bridging Responsible AI Divides), University of Edinburgh, with Inspace, the Institute for Design Informatics and the Edinburgh Futures Institute · deadline 02 Nov 2026 · Around seven commissions with budgets of GBP 8,000 to 12,000 each, inclusive of VAT and all costs. No application fee.

item.title: 4 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Youth Music: Trailblazer Fund (Round 13)
    https://www.youthmusic.org.uk/funding/i-need-funding/trailblazer-fund
    Youth Music · deadline 28 Aug 2026 · GBP 2,000 to GBP 30,000 for organisations in England. No application fee.
  • ITER 2026: International Touring and Environmental Responsibility Programme
    https://juliesbicycle.org/news/iter-2026/
    Julie's Bicycle and in futurum, funded by Arts Council England, Arts Council Norway, Creative Scotland and the Danish Arts Foundation · deadline 01 Sep 2026 · The seminar programme is free to join. Groups of three or more participants can then apply for up to GBP 30,000 for collaborative projects, with funding applications open 6 November 2026 to 11 January 2027 and projects starting spring 2027. No application fee.
  • Arts Council England: Music Growth Fund, GBP 1,000-40,000 strand
    https://www.artscouncil.org.uk/music-growth-package/music-growth-fund-general-guidance
    Arts Council England · deadline 03 Sep 2026 · GBP 1,000 to GBP 40,000, from a total annual budget of GBP 3,000,000 for this strand in 2026/27. You must find at least 25 percent of the total project budget as CASH match funding. No application fee.
  • Trust me, I'm an AI/rtist: Open Call for Creative Interventions
    https://waag.org/en/article/open-call-creative-interventions-trust-me-im-airtist/
    Waag Futurelab (Horizon Europe project HAMLET) · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · EUR 20,000 commission fee excluding VAT, inclusive of artist fee, travel, accommodation and production costs. Applicants must have a VAT number in Europe. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact grants - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• University of East Anglia: Deputy Dean, CUCN-UEA Digital Creativity Institute
    https://vacancies.uea.ac.uk/vacancies/vacancy-search-results.aspx
    University of East Anglia (UEA), Faculty of Arts and Humanities · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · GBP 69,488 to 73,709 per annum depending on qualifications and experience, plus the standard UEA pension and leave package. No application fee.
  • UAL AKO Storytelling Institute: Storytelling Research Fellows 2026 (six posts)
    https://jobs.arts.ac.uk/job/12629-storytelling-research-fellows/
    University of the Arts London (UAL AKO Storytelling Institute), with the Power of Pop Fund · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · GBP 48,563 per annum pro rata (around GBP 19,425 for the part-time fellowship hours), plus UAL benefits. No application fee.
